key.name: clock-font-family
key.description: Font family for the date/time labels. Empty string inherits the panel's default font.

key.name: clock-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the date/time labels.

key.name: panel-height
key.description: Panel height in pixels. 0 uses the shell theme's default height.

key.name: window-color-blend-enabled
key.description: When a window's edge touches the top of the screen, the panel background samples and matches its color there instead of using the default background.
